adaptive.motion_score: maximum 32x24 tile mean absolute RGB delta in millionths of 255

metric.event_match: at least one selected class-matched IoU-0.50 true positive in the annotated event interval
metric.missed_track_opportunity: fewer than two selected class-matched IoU-0.50 true positives in the annotated event interval

selection: among test candidates passing every gate, lowest median samples per source minute; then lower detector CPU; then fixed before adaptive; adaptive threshold selected on calibration only by the same gate and cost ordering
